CheckTitle: Ensure EKS cluster control plane endpoint is not publicly accessible
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks whether EKS cluster API endpoints are publicly accessible from 0.0.0.0/0.
Risk: A public Kubernetes API is exposed to credential attacks and API server vulnerabilities from anywhere on the internet.

Recommendation.Text: Disable the public endpoint (use the private endpoint) or restrict publicAccessCidrs to trusted networks.

Notes: CIS EKS Benchmark 5.4.2; mapped to CIS AWS 3.0 5.2 (internet access to remote administration).
